summary: Baozun Inc. filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing a new share repurchase program authorized by its board on September 24, 2026. The company may buy back up to US$10 million of ADSs (each three Class A shares) and/or Class A ordinary shares over 12 months from September 24, 2026, under the June 16, 2026 AGM mandate, at prevailing market prices on Nasdaq/HKEX. Funded from existing cash excluding global offering proceeds; program is discretionary and may be suspended. Watch for execution pace and mandate renewal as the repurchase authorization rolls off.
